doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Billy Brooks and Oliver Jackson, drummers who left America
summary: Brown raises drummers forgotten after moving to Europe, and Marsalis's drummer Ali Jackson.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, I have to. [laughs] Uh…
I have to do my homework. [laughs]
Now, because I lived in Europe as well, in the ’70s and ’80s, I know there was a drummer named Billy Brooks from America, who lived in Switzerland, and you…
I don’t know him.
Okay, but you recorded a couple things but maybe… I was just wondering because…
Yeah, it’s, it’s possible that we made, but you go into studio…
Right.
…and the session is finished.
Yeah.
Yeah. I know the name now, yes.
Yeah. It’s just unfortunate because like Kenny Clark, once he moved to Europe, people forget about him here.
Yeah.
And Billy… and like Oliver Jackson moved to Paris. People forget about them here.
[inaudible], also.
Yeah. Oliver Jackson, yeah.
Oliver Jackson?
Yeah, he was… Yeah, Paris, yeah.
His son or his nephew plays with Marsalis. The drums.
Hm. Oh. Oh, that’s right. Ali Jackson. Right.
Yeah.
Right, right, right.

Yes. And… I jammed a little bit with Marsalis [on?] one number. And he came up to me and said, “Hey, you know very well Oliver.” “Hey, how’s he doin’?” That sort of thing. Hey… [laughs] It’s great [inaudible]. [laughs]
